data_description.rollover_time: Until this time the previous day's chores can still be ticked off; afterwards open ones count as missed and the new day starts.
data_description.match_names: If a name or nickname is in the title (e.g. "Anna swimming"), the event is shown at that person instead of the calendar owner.
data_description.admin_only_edit: Children can tick off chores and request rewards but cannot change the plan, people or categories.
data_description.show_owner: An event "Anna swimming" in mum's calendar then shows at Anna and at mum.
data_description.reliability_days: Number of days for each person's percentage (default 30).
data_description.school_gap: From this many minutes between two lessons the school day is split into two blocks (leave/home per block). 0 = automatic: at least 45 minutes or twice the travel time plus 15 minutes.

data_description.calendar: Any calendar entity, e.g. Outlook (Remote Calendar), Google, CalDAV, iCloud
data_description.aliases: e.g. Tommy for Tom – events with this name in the title are shown at this person

list_remove.title: Remove list
list_remove.description: The to-do list itself is kept; only categories and assignments are removed.

data_description.optimize_time: Re-sorts everything still under "Other" and tidies up unused categories.
data_description.ai_task: With an AI task (e.g. OpenAI, Google, Ollama) unknown items are sorted sensibly too. Without AI the built-in knowledge list is used.
data_description.prune_days: When the list is full, a category unused for this long makes room for a new one.

design.title: Design
design.description: How should Family Planer look? Cards in your own dashboards can override it with `theme:`.

data.idle_seconds: Return to the start view after

data_description.panel: Opens the complete planner without creating a dashboard – no YAML needed.
data_description.theme: Colours and shapes of all views. "Home Assistant" follows your current HA theme.
data_description.idle_seconds: When another day or a person is tapped on the tablet, the view returns to today after this time without touch.

data_description.title: e.g. 30 minutes gaming, cinema, favourite dinner, $5 pocket money
e.g. 30 minutes gaming, cinema, favourite dinner, $5 pocket money

gamification.title: Points, bonuses & parent PIN
gamification.description: Parent PIN set: {pin}. With the PIN rewards can be approved on the tablet too (admins need no PIN).

data.day_bonus: Bonus for a fully completed day

data_description.default_points: In "per chore" mode the points per chore, in "fair" mode the default weight. Can be changed per chore in the chore plan.
data_description.reward_notify: e.g. the parents' phone app. A Home Assistant notification is always created.
data_description.pin: After 5 wrong entries the PIN is locked for 5 minutes.
data_description.streak_bonus: After 7, 14, 21 … days in a row with everything done.
data_description.mode: Fair: whoever finishes all of their chores of the day gets the same points – whether 2 or 6 chores. Per chore: each chore earns its points, so more chores means more points.
data_description.day_points: Split across the day's chores; each done chore immediately earns its share. The value in the chore plan acts as a weight (e.g. 20 counts twice as much as 10).

announce.title: Announcements on motion
announce.description: When motion is detected in the time window, e.g. Alexa announces who still has chores – or that everything is done.

data.all_done: Also announce when everything is done (once a day)
data.max_items: Chores per person in the announcement

data_description.notify: Alexa: the "Announce" or "Speak" notify entity of the Echo (Alexa Devices integration).
data_description.tts: Alternatively: a TTS entity (e.g. Google Translate, Piper) together with speakers.
data_description.queue: Messages like "reward approved" or your own from automations (e.g. "laundry done") wait for motion and are said once. Expired or completed messages are dropped.
data_description.start: Chore reminders only in this time window.
data_description.cooldown: Pause between two chore reminders, even if motion is detected several times.
data_description.persons: Only these persons are named in the reminder.
data_description.queue_start: Quiet hours: before this a message waits (if still valid).
data_description.queue_end: Quiet hours: after this a message waits until the next morning (if still valid).
data_description.queue_special: Once when the chore becomes due; dropped if it is already done.

vacation.title: Holidays & absence
vacation.description: If a person's calendar has an all-day event with one of these words (e.g. "Ski holiday", "Vacation"), their chores pause on those days – they count neither as done nor as missed. On the first calendar sync the words you use are detected automatically.

data.rescan: Search the calendars for holiday words again

data_description.words: Word endings count too: "Holiday" finds "Summerholiday". Only all-day events or events of at least 20 hours pause chores.
data_description.min_hours: An event with times only counts as a holiday if it lasts at least this many hours on that day (all-day events always count). Default 20.
data_description.refresh_minutes: How often the calendars are checked for new holidays.
data_description.rescan: Searches one year back and ahead and adds the words found.
data_description.scope: Whole family: a holiday in any calendar pauses everyone.

school_edit.title: School – {name}
school_edit.description: Choose a calendar with the lessons (e.g. ICS from WebUntis or your school) or enter fixed times – up to two blocks per day, e.g. morning and afternoon if {name} comes home for lunch. The calendar shows "leave" and "home" per block. With a school calendar, blocks are split automatically when there is enough time to go home between two lessons.

data_description.school_calendar: If a day has events in the school calendar they win; otherwise the fixed times are used.

optimize_lists.name: Optimise lists
optimize_lists.description: Re-sorts all smart lists now (like the daily optimisation).

import_legacy.name: Import prototype
import_legacy.description: Imports plan, history and persons from the prototype to-do lists.

announce.name: Announce chores
announce.description: Announces right away who still has chores (ignores time window and cooldown).

add_points.name: Give points
add_points.description: Give bonus points or take points away.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name or id of the person.

queue_announcement.name: Queue announcement
queue_announcement.description: Message announced once at the next motion, e.g. "The laundry is done, it's Nina's turn".

key.name: Key
key.description: The same key replaces an earlier message; use it to clear.

clear_announcement.name: Clear queued announcement
clear_announcement.description: Removes a message, e.g. when the laundry is already hung up.

missing_entity.title: Family Planer: {entity} is missing
missing_entity.description: The entity `{entity}` (used for {used_by}) no longer exists or is unavailable. Please choose another one under Settings → Devices & services → Family Planer → Configure.
